paras: Groundwater's keelback (Hebius groundwateri) is a species of snake in the family Colubridae. The species is endemic to Thailand.
The specific name, groundwateri, is in honor of zoological illustrator Mr. C.L. Groundwater.
H. groundwateri is found in southern Thailand, in Ranong Province.
The preferred natural habitat of H. groundwateri is forest.
H. groundwateri may attain a total length of 45 cm (18 in), which includes a tail 16.5 cm (6.5 in) long.
